confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors are informed by aggregated Marrakech prices updated in October 2026. Cocktail and wine estimates reflect typical licensed-venue prices and their relationship to draft beer; alcohol prices vary by venue. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates and are less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Food and drink estimates are Marrakech-specific; accommodation estimates use general knowledge of budget and mid-range stays in a major Moroccan tourist city.
